findings.title: Button missing explicit type
findings.message: Your users can submit the form by accident because a `<button>` with no `type` defaults to submit.
findings.help: Always set a `type` on a `<button>`: `type="button"`, `"submit"`, or `"reset"`.

findings.title: iframe missing sandbox attribute

findings.help: Add `sandbox=""` (or a curated value) to your iframe.

findings.title: Control missing accessible label
findings.message: Blind users can't tell what this control does because screen readers find no label, so add visible text, `aria-label`, or `aria-labelledby`.
findings.help: Give every interactive control a label screen readers can read.

findings.title: Role used instead of HTML tag
findings.message: Screen reader users get more reliable semantics from `<datalist>` than `role="listbox"`, so use `<datalist>` instead.
findings.help: Replace `role` with the matching HTML element when one exists.

findings.title: Array index used as a key
findings.message: Your users can see & submit the wrong data when this list reorders or filters, so use a stable id like `key={item.id}`, not the array index "i".
findings.help: Use a stable id from the item, like `key={item.id}` or `key={item.slug}`. Index keys break when the list reorders or filters.

findings.title: Time or random value in JSX
findings.message: This breaks hydration because new Date() reached from JSX gives a different value on the server than in the browser, so move it into useEffect+useState to run only in the browser, or add suppressHydrationWarning to the parent if it's on purpose
findings.help: Move time or random values into useEffect+useState so they only run in the browser, or add suppressHydrationWarning to the parent if it's intentional
